title: New Computer
text:
I finally got a new computer. My last one was an Alienware that I bought from my brother's friend a few years ago. I love my Samsung 34-inch monitor. I kind of prefer it to having two screens, I guess, but I may add more displays soon. I got my first gaming computer around 2020.

Anyway, I need to get a new laptop next. My brother reminded me this morning that I really need a new one because mine is all busted. Right now, I have a Lenovo IdeaPad, and, to be honest, it wasn't bad for $300. I kind of want a MacBook or maybe even an iPad, but I need to check and see what's out there.

title: Late August
text: Yesterday was a strange but pleasant late-August day. It was hot and muggy, and I ate nice ice cream bars all day. I watched a strange movie, Misery (1990), from the Internet Archive, then messed around in Blender, practicing rigging. I don't know; it was just so nice. I guess it was the ice cream that made the day feel dreamy.
